title: GeForce NOW Gives Gamers More Ways to Play at Gamescom 2026
summary: NVIDIA’s Gamescom announcements are revealing what’s next for GeForce NOW, with new ways to play, more supported devices and platforms, and even more big PC games headed to the cloud.
